entities.name: José Luis Mollaghan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Mollaghan was an Argentinian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. From 2014 he was an official of the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith. He had previously held positions in Argentina, including Auxiliary Bishop of Buenos Aires and Archbishop of Rosario.

entities.summary: José Luis Mollaghan was an Argentinian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. From 2014 he was an official of the Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith. He had previously held positions in Argentina, including Auxiliary Bishop of Buenos Aires and Archbishop of Rosario.
